scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev --workspace @apunta/server" "npm run dev --workspace @apunta/web"
scripts.lint: eslint . && prettier --check . && node scripts/check-no-external-urls.mjs && node scripts/collect-licenses.mjs --check && node scripts/check-ui-strings.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @apunta/server && npm run build --workspace @apunta/installer && npm run build --workspace @apunta/web
scripts.eval: npm run build:shared && npm run eval --workspace @apunta/server --
scripts.seed: npm run build:shared && npm run seed --workspace @apunta/server --
